claims.quote: This is somewhat of a misuse of `p2p_port()`. It works, but looking at it I wonder if it can be done better. Maybe introduce `proxy_port(n)`?
claims.request: introduce proxy_port(n) rather than misusing p2p_port(n) for the SOCKS5 proxy
claims.status_note: author set port to 0 as suggested by vasild once port 0 support was added

claims.author: vasild

claims.request: allow tests using auto_outbound_mode to override redirection decisions and listener creation

claims.author: maflcko
claims.harm: manually performing arithmetic on ports risks port collisions across parallel tests or invalid port ranges
claims.quote: my preference would be to not call `+` or `+=` on an integral port returned by a helper function. This will lead to issues down the line

status_by.quote: I cherry-picked the commit from #34186, making it possible to use `port=0` and then let the OS deal with it - much better than assigning the port by the test itself.

claims.status_note: author cherry-picked commit enabling port=0 for OS port allocation

claims.author: vasild
claims.quote: Maybe get `auto_outbound_factory()` and `_create_auto_outbound_listener()` to have the same interface?
claims.request: unify auto_outbound_factory and _create_auto_outbound_listener interfaces to return the listener and remove conditional logic

status_by.quote: I like that suggestion - took it!

claims.status_note: author unified the listener factory interface

claims.author: vasild
claims.quote: Maybe this needs `format_addr_port()` as well, in case the address happens to be IPv6 and needs to be enclosed in `[]`?
claims.request: use format_addr_port() for the proxy address in case an IPv6 address is configured

status_by.quote: Right, only if changed in the future.

claims.status_note: author noted proxy address is hardcoded to 127.0.0.1; vasild conceded it only matters if changed in the future

claims.author: vasild
claims.quote: Maybe add such argument also to `disconnect_last_block_relay_peer()` for consistency?
claims.request: make node argument consistent across helper functions or drop it from all since all operate on self.nodes[0]

status_by.quote: I decided to drop the node arg everywhere.

claims.status_note: author dropped node argument across helper functions

claims.author: vasild
claims.question: whether a stale-tip extra-outbound connection could be initiated between advancing mocktime and calling generate
claims.quote: Is there an unlikely scenario that a stale-tip extra-outbound connection is initiated after advancing the mocktime and before `self.generate(node, 1)`?

status_by.quote: I think probably not in practice - `CheckForStaleTipAndEvictPeers` fires every 45 seconds (on a steady clock, not influenced by the mocktime bump).

claims.status_note: author explained CheckForStaleTipAndEvictPeers fires on steady clock independent of mocktime

claims.author: vasild
claims.question: whether the node could already have connections to all reachable networks when the function starts, causing has_extra_full_outbound_peer to time out
claims.quote: Is it possible that the node already has at least one connection to all reachable networks when this function starts? Would that result in timeouts due to `has_extra_full_outbound_peer(node)` never returning `True`?

status_by.quote: What about the tor and cjdns connections being established after adding to addrman and before `wait_for_network_specific_peer()` is called?

claims.status_note: vasild followed up asking whether Tor and CJDNS connections could be made before wait_for_network_specific_peer is called

claims.author: vasild

claims.request: pass requested destination address and port to auto_outbound_factory in addition to connection index
